summary: United Maritime Corp filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release reporting improved Q1 2026 financial results and declaring a quarterly cash dividend of $0.10 per share. The press release also describes vessel acquisitions and sales, but these are operational updates, not a special-situation transaction. No change of control, tender offer, restructuring, or strategic review is announced. The filing is a routine earnings and dividend report with no special-situation classification.
